Extract N-Mixture Quantities from MCMC Draws

Source: R/nmix.R
nmix_draws.Rd

Picks the posterior draws of \(\lambda_i\), \(p_{ij}\) and (optionally) \(N_i\) out of a matrix of MCMC draws whose columns are named as in JAGS/BUGS output (lambda[1], p[1,1], N[1], ...).

Usage

nmix_draws(draws, I, J, lambda = "lambda", p = "p", N = "N")

Arguments

draws

A non-empty numeric matrix or data frame of finite draws with unique, named columns, or a non-empty list of matrices/data frames with the same columns (chains are stacked).

I

Positive integer giving the number of sites.

J

Positive integer giving the number of visits.

lambda, p, N

Non-empty node-name prefixes for \(\lambda\), \(p\) and \(N\). Set N = NULL to skip \(N\). If not all requested N columns are present, the returned N element is NULL.

Value

A list with lambda (\(S \times I\)), p (\(S \times IJ\), columns ordered as \(i + (j-1)I\)) and N (\(S \times I\) or NULL when the columns are absent).

Examples

I <- 2; J <- 2; S <- 3
draws <- matrix(runif(S * (I + I * J)), S, I + I * J)
colnames(draws) <- c(paste0("lambda[", 1:I, "]"),
                     paste0("p[", rep(1:I, J), ",", rep(1:J, each = I), "]"))
str(nmix_draws(draws, I, J))
#> List of 3
#>  $ lambda: num [1:3, 1:2] 0.9972 0.3039 0.1489 0.3285 0.0705 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : NULL
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:2] "lambda[1]" "lambda[2]"
#>  $ p     : num [1:3, 1:4] 0.14 0.49 0.297 0.303 0.441 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : NULL
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:4] "p[1,1]" "p[2,1]" "p[1,2]" "p[2,2]"
#>  $ N     : NULL
